attempted_claim: Let (M^4,g,f) be a four-dimensional complete gradient shrinking Ricci soliton with half positive isotropic curvature (one of the two curvature-operator blocks A or C is positive definite). Must (M^4,g,f) be isometric to S^4, CP^2, or a finite quotient of S^3 x R, without assuming that the Ricci tensor has an eigenvalue of multiplicity three?
decisive_failure: The full half-PIC classification without the Ricci-multiplicity-3 hypothesis remains open: the obstruction computation rules out only the natural pure-A pinching-cone family and the model spectra verify only standard examples, so neither a proof nor a counterexample was established and a future B-control estimate could still succeed.
